scenario.name: Wyrmling Lair
scenario.description: Tier 2 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) boss encounter: four Level 5 adventurers (Fighter, Wizard, Cleric, Rogue) battle a Red Dragon Wyrmling, two Cinder Hounds (one held back), and an Ember Magmin—all fire-immune—testing damage-immunity awareness, breath-weapon spacing, Bless + Shield economy, Vex + Nick mastery combos, and multi-round focus fire.

actions.rationale: No ally is engaged yet, so I have no Sneak Attack setup, and meleeing the Magmin risks its death burst. I'll shoot it with piercing damage from range to start whittling down the easiest kill. I'll keep my movement to reposition after the shot.
actions.table_talk: Opening on the Magmin with arrows. Remember everything here is fire-immune, so use cold or force, Lyra. Don't stand next to the Magmin when it drops.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Ember Magmin with Shortbow (25 vs AC 14) for 9 piercing damage.

actions.rationale: My action is spent on the shortbow hit. Off-hand attack needs a Light melee attack first, and I have no Cunning Action option listed. I'm holding this spot, which is spread out from allies so one fire breath can't catch two of us. It's also outside the 10-ft Magmin death-burst radius.
actions.table_talk: Magmin's bloodied and close to dropping. Finish it at range so nobody is next to it when it bursts. Stay spread out against the dragon's cone breath.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 3 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound moves 15 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 3 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 11 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 23 damage.
Lyra Starweave fails against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 23 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 3 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Red Dragon Wyrmling moves 20 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 3 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 16 damage.
Dorian Dawnshield saves against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 8 damage.
Lyra Starweave drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Lyra Starweave fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 16 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Ember Magmin's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Closing to melee reach of Kaelen Whisper.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin moves 10 ft to (15, 20).

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Touch.
narrative_hooks: Ember Magmin hits Kaelen Whisper with Touch (17 vs AC 16) for 6 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Lyra is down and Kaelen is at 5 HP. Mass Healing Word as a bonus action gets Lyra back up and stabilizes all three of the most hurt party members, including me at 12 HP. That leaves my action free for a cantrip or Dodge.
actions.table_talk: Lyra, back on your feet! Everyone spread out. The wyrmling's breath recharges, so don't bunch up in a cone.
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield casts Mass Healing Word, restoring 10 HP to Lyra Starweave (regains consciousness, remains Prone).
Dorian Dawnshield casts Mass Healing Word, restoring 10 HP to Kaelen Whisper.
Dorian Dawnshield casts Mass Healing Word, restoring 10 HP to Dorian Dawnshield.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling and hound-1 are adjacent and the Magmin is 10 ft away, so all three fall inside a 15-ft emanation. Spirit Guardians deals radiant damage, which gets around their fire immunity, and it hits again each round. Allies are excluded from the area, and casting it uses my remaining action.
actions.table_talk: Spirit Guardians is up. The wyrmling, hound and Magmin are all in my aura and taking radiant damage. Kaelen, finish the Magmin from range. Lyra, stand up and stay back.
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield casts Spirit Guardians (DC 15 WIS): Dorian Dawnshield succeeds and takes 11 radiant/necrotic damage.

actions.rationale: My action and bonus action are both spent. Moving out of reach of the hound and the wyrmling would provoke two Opportunity Attacks while I'm at 11 HP. Staying put keeps both of them inside Spirit Guardians, so they take radiant damage on their turns.
actions.table_talk: I'm holding the line with the hound and the wyrmling in my aura. Kaelen, Lyra, keep your distance and focus fire. No fire damage on anything!
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Close 10 ft to reach the wyrmling and hound at (10,15) while staying 10 ft from the bloodied Magmin so I'm clear of its death burst. Next I'll attack the wyrmling with longsword (Sap) to blunt its attacks.
actions.table_talk: Moving up on the wyrmling. I'll Sap its attacks so it hurts the squishies less. Lyra, stay back out of cone range!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance moves 10 ft to (5, 10).

actions.rationale: The wyrmling is the biggest threat and is in reach. A Longsword hit applies Sap, giving it Disadvantage on its next attack while my wounded allies recover. Slashing damage avoids the fire immunity, and it stays in Dorian's Spirit Guardians aura.
actions.table_talk: On the wyrmling and sapping its strikes. Lyra, stay low and back off once you're up!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Longsword (13 vs AC 17).

actions.rationale: My Extra Attack swing goes on the wyrmling, the biggest threat. Slashing damage gets around its fire immunity. A Longsword hit applies Sap, giving its next attack Disadvantage, which protects our low-HP casters. The schema has no reroll intent, so I'm keeping Heroic Inspiration for later and making a fresh attack.
actions.table_talk: Swinging at the wyrmling again. If this lands, its next bite or claw is sapped. Dorian, keep it in your aura!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Longsword (14 vs AC 17).

actions.rationale: My action is spent and I have no attacks left. No bonus action options are listed, and I'm at full HP. The reroll prompt has no matching intent in my schema, so I can't use it. Staying put keeps me in melee with the wyrmling and hound, so they have to deal with me and Dorian's Spirit Guardians. Moving away would provoke Opportunity Attacks for no benefit.
actions.table_talk: Both swings whiffed on the wyrmling. I'm holding the line next to Dorian. Kaelen, drop the Magmin from range; Lyra, stand up and stay well back from the cone.
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: I'm standing up first so my attacks don't suffer disadvantage from being prone. I'm also stepping back to 20 ft from the wyrmling, which gets me out of its 15-ft cone breath. Next I'll finish the bloodied Magmin with force damage (Magic Missile), since everything here is fire-immune.
actions.table_talk: Up and backing off out of cone range. Magic Missiles incoming on the Magmin. Kaelen, brace for its burst!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave spends 15 ft of movement to stand up from Prone.
Lyra Starweave moves 10 ft to (0, 35).

actions.rationale: The Magmin is bloodied, and Magic Missile is force damage that auto-hits, so it should finish the Magmin without risking a miss. I'm 15 ft away, outside the death burst. Fire spells are useless here since everything is fire-immune.
actions.table_talk: Three force darts into the Magmin. Kaelen, you're 5 ft from it, so brace for the burst or step back next turn!
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Ember Magmin for 9 force damage.
Ember Magmin drops to 0 HP and is defeated.
Ember Magmin explodes in a 10-ft burst!

actions.rationale: My action is spent. I'm using the last 5 ft of movement to back off to 25 ft from the wyrmling and hound, which keeps me out of the 15-ft cone and spread from allies. I'm saving the slot rather than casting Misty Step, since the dragon's speed would close the gap anyway; that slot is better kept for Shield or a damage spell.
actions.table_talk: Magmin's down! I'm hanging back at range. Next turn I'll hit the wyrmling with cold or force.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave moves 5 ft to (0, 40).

actions.rationale: My action and movement are spent. Misty Step won't escape enemies this fast: the wyrmling flies 60 ft and the hounds move 50 ft. It would also cost a slot I need for Shield or next turn's cold/force damage. Better to stay 25 ft back and save the reaction for Shield.
actions.table_talk: Holding at range with Shield ready. Next turn I'm on the wyrmling with force or cold. Keep it busy up front!
narrative_hooks: Round 1: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 2 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound B moves 40 ft to (10, 15).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 2 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Dorian Dawnshield loses concentration on spirit-guardians (dropped_to_0_hp).
Dorian Dawnshield drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Dorian Dawnshield fails against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 16 damage.
Aldric Vance saves against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 8 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Aldric is adjacent to the wyrmling, so Sneak Attack applies. A piercing shortsword hit avoids its fire immunity, and the Vex mastery gives me advantage on my follow-up off-hand dagger. I can't heal Dorian, so the best help is dropping the biggest threat fast.
actions.table_talk: Dorian's down and I've got no healing. Aldric, can you get him a potion? I'm sneak-attacking the wyrmling while you've got it flanked.
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Shortsword (18 vs AC 17) for 9 piercing damage.
Vex mastery grants Kaelen Whisper Advantage on the next attack against Red Dragon Wyrmling.

actions.rationale: My action is spent and the only legal bonus action is the off-hand Light attack. The dagger hits the wyrmling with the Advantage from Vex, and Aldric is adjacent to it, so Sneak Attack applies if it wasn't used on the first hit. Piercing damage avoids its fire immunity.
actions.table_talk: Off-hand dagger into the wyrmling with Vex advantage. Aldric, Dorian's down at 0 HP right next to you; please get a potion into him!
narrative_hooks: Kaelen Whisper misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Dagger (15 vs AC 17).

actions.rationale: Forced end_turn fallback after exhausting retries.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Attacking Kaelen Whisper in melee with Multiattack.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound hits Kaelen Whisper with Bite (21 vs AC 16) for 12 damage.
Kaelen Whisper drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Cinder Hound hits Kaelen Whisper with Bite (22 vs AC 16) for 14 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Red Dragon Wyrmling's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance fails against Red Dragon Wyrmling's Fire Breath (DC 13) and takes 23 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Dorian Dawnshield's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Aldric Vance's turn begins.

actions.rationale: No healing or potion action is available, and Dorian and Kaelen can't be revived this turn. The best play is to pressure the wyrmling, the main threat and already damaged, with the longsword. Sap gives its next attack Disadvantage, which protects me at 11 HP. Slashing damage avoids its fire immunity.
actions.table_talk: I can't get a potion to anyone right now. I'm sapping the wyrmling to keep it off us. Lyra, keep hitting it with force or cold from range and stay out of the cone!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Red Dragon Wyrmling with Longsword (17 vs AC 17) for 6 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Red Dragon Wyrmling Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: The wyrmling's next attack already has Disadvantage from Sap, and that doesn't stack. So my last Extra Attack goes for the most damage: Greatsword's Graze still deals 4 damage on a miss. It's slashing, which the fire-immune wyrmling doesn't resist, and keeps focus on the boss.
actions.table_talk: Wyrmling's sapped. Piling on with the greatsword. Lyra, keep force or cold on it and stay out of the cone. Both of our downed allies need pickups as soon as anyone frees up!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance misses Red Dragon Wyrmling with Greatsword (15 vs AC 17).
Graze mastery still deals 4 slashing damage to Red Dragon Wyrmling.

actions.rationale: I have no Action or attacks left, and no bonus actions are listed. I'm at 11 HP with three enemies in reach, so moving away would provoke Opportunity Attacks. Holding position next to downed Dorian keeps me guarding him with my reaction ready.
actions.table_talk: I'm tapped out this turn but holding the line over Dorian. Lyra, keep force or cold on the wyrmling from range and stay out of the cone. Pick up Dorian or Kaelen if you can!
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Lyra Starweave's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Every enemy is immune to fire, so Fireball and Scorching Ray are out. Shatter or Lightning Bolt would likely catch Kaelen and Dorian, and damage to downed allies adds death-save failures. An upcast Magic Missile puts 5 guaranteed force darts on the wyrmling for focus fire, and I can still back away afterwards.
actions.table_talk: Five force darts into the wyrmling! I'm staying out of the cone. Aldric, I have no healing, so the pickups are on you if you get a chance.
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave casts Magic Missile at Red Dragon Wyrmling for 15 force damage.

actions.rationale: My action is already spent on Magic Missile. I'm 25 ft from every enemy, well outside the wyrmling's 15-ft cone. Misty Step or moving closer would only spend resources or expose me. I have no healing for the downed allies, and Shield stays up as my reaction.
actions.table_talk: Holding back at range with Shield ready. Aldric, the wyrmling's taken a lot of force damage, so keep it pinned. Pickups on Dorian first if you can manage one!
narrative_hooks: Round 2: Cinder Hound B's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Aldric Vance fails against Cinder Hound B's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 23 damage.

actions.rationale: Monster action spent; ending turn.
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Kaelen Whisper's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Auto-skipped (incapacitated or 0 HP).
narrative_hooks: Round 3: Cinder Hound's turn begins.

actions.rationale: Repositioning to catch 1 target(s) in Fire Breath cone.
narrative_hooks: Cinder Hound moves 20 ft to (0, 35).

actions.rationale: Unleashing Fire Breath against 1 target(s).
narrative_hooks: Lyra Starweave drops to 0 HP and falls Unconscious and Prone.
Lyra Starweave saves against Cinder Hound's Fire Breath (DC 12) and takes 10 damage.
